paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Zohar, Naso 148a: Rabbi Abba was going to Lod, and Rabbi Zeira bar Rav met him.

notes.text: The supplied Zohar locator Naso 148a and the meeting of Rabbi Abba with Zeira bar Rav have no matching named passage in the returned evidence. This occurrence remains unverified; no absence from the Zohar as a whole is asserted.

Zohar III 148a, in Naso, names Rabbi Zeira bar Rav in this encounter. Rabbi Abba is traveling to Lod when they meet. The conversation continues with a question about who counted Abraham’s faith as righteousness in Genesis 15:6.
